title: Certificates of Deposit: whether a same-tier renewal earns the Relationship Bonus
content:
## Scope

This rule applies when a Certificates of Deposit certificate renews into its own tier after the grace period. It decides, from the owner's checking account, whether the new term earns the Relationship Bonus.

## Rule

The Relationship Bonus is earned on the renewal when the owner holds, on the renewal date, an active checking account of a tier listed among the certificate tier's qualifying checking tiers.

## Input, judgement, output

| Input read from the bank's records | Judgement | Output |
|---|---|---|
| The owner's active checking account and its checking tier, on the renewal date | Is that checking tier one of the certificate tier's qualifying checking tiers? | Yes: the Relationship Bonus is earned. No, or no active checking account: it is not earned |

## Cases (hypothetical owners)

| Owner's checking position on the renewal date | Earned on the renewal? |
|---|---|
| Active checking account of a qualifying tier | Yes |
| Active checking account of a tier not listed for this certificate tier | No |
| The only checking account of a qualifying tier was closed before the renewal date | No, there is no active qualifying account on the renewal date |
| No checking account at all | No |

## Points of judgement

**The old term carried the Relationship Bonus because the owner then held a qualifying account. Does the new term keep it?**
Only if the owner holds an active checking account of a qualifying tier on the renewal date; the question is asked afresh on that date.

**The owner opened a qualifying checking account a week before the renewal date. Does it count?**
Yes, provided it is active on the renewal date and its tier is one of the qualifying checking tiers.
